name: alibaba/wan/2.6/flash/image-to-video
description: Wan 2.6 Flash by Alibaba - animate still images into dynamic videos with AI. Transform photos into cinematic clips with natural motion, camera movement, and optional audio generation.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description:
URL of the audio to use as the background music. Must be publicly accessible.
Limit handling: If the audio duration exceeds the duration value (5, 10, or 15 seconds),
the audio is truncated to the first N seconds, and the rest is discarded. If
the audio is shorter than the video, the remaining part of the video will be silent.
For example, if the audio is 3 seconds long and the video duration is 5 seconds, the
first 3 seconds of the output video will have sound, and the last 2 seconds will be silent.
- Format: WAV, MP3.
- Duration: 3 to 30 s.
- File size: Up to 15 MB.

image.title: Image
image.description: URL of the image to use as the first frame. Must be publicly accessible or base64 data URI. Image dimensions must be between 240 and 7680.

Shot 2 [4-8s] Smash cut: the printed paper flies into the air and unfolds into a full desert canyon scene around the desk, like reality is being unrolled. Creator says: "Wait—my prompt has physics?"
Shot 3 [8-12s] Hard cut: the paper tears and reveals a tropical jungle behind it, perfectly lit, cinematic sun. Creator laughs: "This is exactly why we do AI."
Shot 4 [12-15s] Hard cut back to studio. The printer prints a final line (not shown clearly). Creator looks to camera: "Multi-scene. Single prompt."

readme:
# Wan 2.6 Flash Image to Video

The fast, lower-cost Wan 2.6 image-to-video tier. Animate a picture into a 5, 10, or 15 second clip; turn on `multi_shots` to let the model cut between shots.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Text instruction. |
| `image` | image URL, required | — | First frame. JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. |
| `audio` | audio URL | — | Optional WAV/MP3 URL that drives speech or rhythm. |
| `resolution` | `720p` / `1080p` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `duration` | 5 / 10 / 15 | 5 | Output length in seconds. |
| `multi_shots` | boolean | false | Let the model cut between several shots. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |

## Billing

You pay for output seconds: $0.05 at 720p and $0.075 at 1080p.

| Output | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|
| 5s (default) | $0.25 | $0.375 |
| 10s | $0.50 | $0.75 |
| 15s | $0.75 | $1.125 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe the motion and camera move in one or two sentences.
- With `multi_shots`, list the shots in order.

## Limits

- Use the non-Flash tier when motion quality matters more than speed and cost.

## Also on SandBase

Other Wan 2.6 endpoints: `alibaba/wan/2.6/text-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.6/image-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.6/reference-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.6/flash/reference-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.6/text-to-image`, `alibaba/wan/2.6/image-to-image`, `alibaba/wan/2.7/text-to-video` (newer).
